vcp_breakouts.description: Select top VCP breakouts with strong fundamentals and BUY/STRONG_BUY trading signals.
vcp_breakouts.sql:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
),
latest_vcp_picks AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT vcp.symbol, vcp.price, vcp.vcp_score, vcp.enhanced_fund_score, ss.trading_signal
    FROM latest_vcp_picks vcp
    JOIN latest_snapshots ss ON vcp.symbol = ss.symbol
    WHERE vcp.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
    ORDER BY vcp.vcp_score DESC, vcp.rank ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT * FROM candidates;

synthesis_guidance: {'align_contexts': 'Ensure context alignment between VCP scores and trading signals.', 'review_parameters': 'Parameterize query limits for flexible selection.'}
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 1486
